description: The TASKS of a Pipedrive project — the checklist inside it, which is where a project template actually keeps its content. Without this you can only see which phase a project sits in, not what it asks you to do. Required: project_id. Returns each task with title, phase, assignee, due date and done state. A project without tasks returns an empty list, not an error.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_pipedrive_project_tasks
